recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the original XDS/MHD note for FHIR-5561 unless a new work-group decision revisits category/class guidance across Composition and DocumentReference.
issue_request: FHIR-5561 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1. It asked to improve Composition.type and Composition.class definitions according to DocumentReference work, with the final resolution leaving Composition.type/class as the basis, making DocumentReference.type/class match, and appending an XDS/MHD metadata-field note to both class elements.
initial_application: The issue was historically applied in svn r5892 / git commit a4f7d63ab3, which added the XDS/MHD metadata-field note to the old spreadsheet sources for Composition.class and DocumentReference.class. Those sources were later migrated into current StructureDefinition XML files.
additional_context: FHIR-13917 later replaced the DocumentReference class XDS/MHD note with metadata/search-filtering wording; FHIR-17171 and FHIR-17555 renamed DocumentReference.class and Composition.class to category and increased cardinality; and FHIR-31668 explicitly removed the Composition.category XDS/MHD note because Composition.category was no longer XDS classCode. SDWG minutes confirm the FHIR-31668 6-0-0 motion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Composition and DocumentReference are active resources, current type/category definitions are aligned, DocumentReference.category retains an XDS DocumentEntry.classCode mapping, and Composition.category intentionally has no XDS/MHD comment under FHIR-31668.
